tasks.q_en: Kevin is on the rope above the garden! You can see everything from the window and report straight away: what has already happened, what has just happened, what hasn't happened yet. Every second counts.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Present perfect with just / already / yet. just = a moment ago (He's just landed). already = sooner than expected (They've already climbed). yet in negatives = not so far (Mum hasn't arrived yet) and in questions (Have you cut it yet?). just and already go before the participle; yet goes at the end.
tasks.q_pl: Present perfect with just / already / yet. just = a moment ago (He's just landed). already = sooner than expected (They've already climbed). yet in negatives = not so far (Mum hasn't arrived yet) and in questions (Have you cut it yet?). just and already go before the participle; yet goes at the end.
tasks.q_en: Present perfect with just / already / yet. just = a moment ago (He's just landed). already = sooner than expected (They've already climbed). yet in negatives = not so far (Mum hasn't arrived yet) and in questions (Have you cut it yet?). just and already go before the participle; yet goes at the end.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Кевін біжить через сад до будинку Марлі, щоб сховатися. Але біля чужих дверей його хапають дві великі руки. Гаррі. «Попався, малий». Ти тиснеш на кнопку рації — тиша.
end_good.text_pl: Kevin biegnie przez ogród do domu Marleya, żeby się schować. Ale przy obcych drzwiach chwytają go dwie wielkie ręce. Harry. „Mam cię, mały”. Naciskasz przycisk krótkofalówki — cisza.
end_good.text_en: Kevin runs through the garden to Marley's house to hide. But at the strange door, two big hands grab him. Harry. “Gotcha, kid.” You press the button on the walkie-talkie: silence.
